description:
A security incident has been detected. The Security Operations Center (SOC) reports that the external IP address '198.51.100.42' is involved in a credential stuffing attack against the Aerobridge server.

Your task is to:
1. Analyze the server logs at '/var/log/aerobridge_server.log' to identify which internal user account successfully logged in from the malicious IP '198.51.100.42'.
2. Log in to the Aerobridge Administration Panel (http://localhost:8000/admin/) using credentials 'admin' / 'adminpass123'.
3. Navigate to the Users section and deactivate (set 'Active' to false) ONLY the compromised account you identified. Do not delete the user, just deactivate them.
4. Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/incident_report.txt' containing the username of the compromised account.
